description: Given that one of the following properties is set, the form will only submit when the respective condition is fulfilled. Otherwise, a validation error will be displayed.

required.description: Form field must contain a value.

validationType.description: Use predefined validation patterns. Available options are: Email, Phone, and Custom (empty).

pattern.description: Form field value must match the provided RegEx pattern.

minLength.description: Form field value must be at least the provided length.

maxLength.description: Form field value must be at most the provided length.

min.description: Form field value must be at least the provided number.

max.description: Form field value must be at most the provided number.

patternErrorMessage.description: The error message to display when the input does not match the regular expression.

requiredMessage.description: The error message to display when a required field is empty.

minMessage.description: The error message to display when the value is below the minimum.

maxMessage.description: The error message to display when the value is above the maximum.

minLengthMessage.description: The error message to display when the value length is below the minimum.

maxLengthMessage.description: The error message to display when the value length is above the maximum.

emailMessage.description: The error message to display when the email validation fails.

phoneMessage.description: The error message to display when the phone validation fails.

customValidators.description: Custom validator names to run. Can be a single validator name or an array of validator names.
